name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A set of ready-made skills and a playbook that teaches AI coding agents a disciplined, step-by-step way to build software properly instead of improvising as they go.
buyer: A solo developer or small startup team that relies heavily on AI coding assistants and wants fewer bugs and more structure in how those agents work.
business_use_cases: A solo indie developer installs it so their AI coding agent follows a consistent, disciplined process — plan, test, review — instead of writing sloppy one-shot code.
A dev agency standardizes this methodology across every client project so AI-assisted work stays reliable regardless of which engineer sets it up.
A coding bootcamp or course creator teaches it as 'best practices for working with AI agents' to paying students.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid onboarding sprint helping teams adopt this methodology and customize it for their own stack

steal_this: Package a short paid call or course that helps a dev team install and customize this methodology for their own codebase and workflow.
